name: Identify Transcription Factor Binding Sites
description: Identifies binding sites for a specific transcription factor in a genomic sequence.
detailed_description: Identifies binding sites for a specific transcription factor in a genomic sequence.
when_to_use: When you need identify transcription factor binding sites analysis

parameters.sequence: [Required] The genomic DNA sequence to analyze (str)
parameters.tf_name: [Required] Name of the transcription factor to search for (e.g., 'Hsf1', 'GATA1') (str)
parameters.threshold: [Optional] Minimum score threshold for reporting binding sites (0.0-1.0) (default: 0.8)
